original.statement: A Tailscale certificate resolver was added to Traefik's TLS support; it is new and optional.

decision.reason: [ev-7d645bb4f295] lists "[tls] Add Tailscale certificate resolver" under v3.0.0 Enhancements, so "added" is the right change type. The excerpt gives no configuration key path or other schema identity. That leaves a free-form TLS protocol-behavior subject as the best fit, and its kebab-case name "tailscale-certificate-resolver" uses only the evidence's own words. Confidence is low because the family choice is inferred rather than stated.
